main_text.p: Hoc tempore MAXIMILIANVS rex cum ALBERTO SAXONIÆ ducé comparat de Frisia subigenda : e[?]Albertus velut Sciringÿs[?] auxilio futurus militem in Frisiam mittit : Ei mox alium, diffimulato nomine & consilio suo, submittit Vetcopero-Maximiliani regis & Albertii Saxonis confilia. rum, stipendia facturum, ut regionem atte-rerent, & enervem redderent. Tum cum maturum videretur, fessis[?] penè omnibus diploma in Frisiam missum, quo Frisiae gubernatio e[?]Al-berto Saxoni sub Potestatis titulo à e[?]Maximi-liano, & ordinibus imperij assignabatur, eaq; ju-Diploma Alberto Saxoni datum, bebatur esse perpetua, transfitura in hæredes. Ad-ditum tamen, ut belli impendijs refusis, & certâ pecunię summa soluta, à Philippo Burgundo e[?]Maximiliani filio, gubernatio tota & omne in Frisiam jus ad eundem transfiret. e[?]Albertus per suos, quos præmiserat, oppressis omnib. Transla-vicanis, atq; à fœdere Groningano vi & aperto bello aversis, inq; fidem suam adactis, Groningam quoq; & agrum vicinum tentavit. Nam hos quo-q; ad imperium sibi commissum pertinere ferebat, habebatq; pro se interpretem controversiæ Maxi-milianum. Verum cum res per intercessiones & colloquia non procederet, ipse ob filij casum, quem Tranflavicani Franekeræ[?] obsederant, secundo in Frisiam veniens, liberato filio, & rebus Tranflavicanis pro tempore constitutis exercitum eis Lavicam adduxit, nulloq; negocio agrum in suam potestatem & fidem redegit. Sed in obsi-denda urbe dum haret, intercedente rursum
e[?] = ornamental mark in the text, presumably a reference or a flourish.

page.notes: Printed as one page. The left margin holds two notes: "Maximiliani regis & Albertii Saxonis confilia." (beside lines 5 to 7) and "Diploma Alberto Saxoni datum," (beside lines 9 to 11). The quotation marks „ at the start of lines 11 to 16 stand at the margin and are included as text. The symbol "e[?]" before Albertus and Maximiliani is an ornament, not an e; its exact form is uncertain. The large initial at the start of "habebatq;" and the line-end "quo-" with "q;" on the next line may be misread. "Sciringÿs" is unclear. Italic boundaries are approximate after line 16. The word "Franekeræ" is uncertain. The running head is set in capitals and may be read imperfectly. The catchword "GEOR-" is at the right below the last line.
